description: Puts the draft back to the published version: every change made since it was published is lost (nothing on air changes). draftRevision (required) is the draft you reviewed: if it changed after that, nothing is discarded (CONFLICT). dryRun: true lists what would be lost and discards nothing — show the user that first. Refused (NOT_PUBLISHED) when nothing is published.

draftRevision.description: The draftRevision of the answer you reviewed (every scene_get and scene_set answer has one)

dryRun.description: true: only say what would be lost. Omitted or false: the draft is discarded

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

name: discard_scene_draft

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Discard a scene's draft
